ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtected.h: Backups are on, but Murage has no recent backup it could check.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtected.m: If this computer fails now, your recent work may not come back.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupNotProtected.c: Open Backups to run one now and see why the last one did not finish.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.title: A scheduled backup is overdue
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.happen: A scheduled backup did not run on time.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.matter: A little. Your newest work is not backed up yet.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupOverdue.canDo: Murage tries again at the next scheduled time. You can also run one now in Backups.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.title: A backup started and has not finished
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.happen: A backup started and has run past its time.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.matter: A little. Your newest work is not backed up until one finishes.
ux.l2b.health.issue.backupStalled.canDo: Murage keeps watching it. Open Backups to see where it is and start again.
ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.title: Heavy disk writes while Murage was idle
ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.happened: Murage kept writing to disk while it had nothing to do.
ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.matters: It can slow this computer down. Murage slows its own work down when it gets too heavy.
ux.l2b.health.issue.ioPressure.canDo: Open Storage to see what is taking up room.
ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.title: Memory learning got replies it could not use
ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.happened: The engine Murage learns with sent back replies Murage could not use.
ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.matters: Your bots keep working. They learn less from recent conversations until this clears.
ux.l2b.health.issue.extraction.canDo: Open Memory settings to try what was skipped, or pick a different engine for learning.
ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.title: Some messages stopped after every retry
ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.happened: Some messages did not get an answer, even after every retry.
ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.matters: Yes, for those messages. Each one shows what happened in its own chat.
ux.l2b.health.issue.dispatch.canDo: Open Engines to check sign-in and limits, then send the message again.
ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.title: An engine kept its files open and held up cleanup
ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.happened: An engine kept its files open, so Murage is waiting to clean up.
ux.l2b.health.issue.engineHolds.canDo: Nothing to do, Murage is on it. Closing the engine's own app finishes this sooner.
ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.title: Some deleted conversations are still being removed
ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.happened: These conversations are gone from your chats. Murage is still clearing the copies left in an engine's files.
ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.matters: No. Murage finishes this by itself.
ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.mattersUpda: No. Murage tries again after its next update.
ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.mattersSome: No. Murage finishes some of this by itself, and tries the rest again after its next update.
ux.l2b.health.issue.deletion.canDo: Nothing to do, Murage is on it.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.title: A conversation keeps rebuilding its history before sending
ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.happened: A conversation keeps rebuilding its history before each message goes out.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.matters: Only a little. Messages still go out, a bit more slowly.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sendFence.canDo: Nothing to do, Murage is on it.
ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.title: A conversation keeps starting a new engine session
ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.happened: The engine keeps starting a conversation again in a new session.
ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.matters: Your messages are kept. The engine may need a moment to catch up.
ux.l2b.health.issue.resets.canDo: Nothing to do, Murage is on it.
ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.title: Some skill files could not be read and were skipped
ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.happe: A personal skill or agent has no usable name in its file, so Murage went by the file name.
ux.l2b.health.issue.isolationNoise.matte: No. This is routine and your bots work as usual.
ux.l2b.health.issue.silentServer.title: Murage has not sent fresh health information
ux.l2b.health.issue.silentServer.happene: Murage's health figures have not come in for a while.
ux.l2b.health.issue.silentDesktop.title: The desktop app has not sent fresh health information
ux.l2b.health.issue.silentDesktop.happen: The desktop app's health figures have not come in for a while.
ux.l2b.health.issue.statsStale.title: Storage figures are waiting for a fresh reading
ux.l2b.health.issue.statsStale.happened: Storage figures are older than they should be.
ux.l2b.health.issue.scanFailing.title: Recent health checks did not finish
ux.l2b.health.issue.scanFailing.happened: The last few health checks stopped before they finished.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceServer.title: Health information from Murage is waiting for a fresh reading
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceServer.happene: Murage's health figures could not be read just now.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDesktop.title: Health information from the desktop app is waiting for a fresh reading
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDesktop.happen: The desktop app's health figures could not be read just now.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceBackup.title: Backup status is waiting for a fresh reading
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceBackup.happene: The backup status could not be read just now.
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDbStats.title: Storage figures are waiting to be read
ux.l2b.health.issue.sourceDbStats.happen: Storage figures could not be read just now.
ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.title: A health check found something to look at
ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.happened: A health check found something this version of Murage has no words for yet.
ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.matters: Nothing has stopped because of it.
ux.l2b.health.issue.unknown.canDo: Nothing to do right now. If it stays, ask your bot about it.
ux.l2b.health.issue.coverage.matters: Your bots keep working. Health may be a little out of date until then.
ux.l2b.health.issue.coverage.canDo: Nothing to do, Murage is on it. This clears with the next reading.
ux.l2b.health.lineWatch: Worth a look, nothing is urgent.
ux.l2b.health.lineNote: Everything that needs you is done. Murage is finishing a few things.
ux.l2b.health.settingsLine: What Murage's checks found, and what to do about it.
ux.l2b.health.deletion.retryFailed: Murage could not try again just now. It keeps trying by itself.
ux.l2b.health.deletion.pending: Still clearing: {n}. The oldest is {age} old.
ux.l2b.health.need.title: Health
ux.l2b.health.need.fluxUsedUp: Add more Flux allowance so your bots can carry on.
ux.l2b.health.need.fluxKey: Check your Flux key so your bots can carry on.
ux.l2b.health.need.engine: Your bots need this engine to answer.
ux.l2b.health.deletion.holding: Waiting for {engines} to close. Murage finishes this by itself after that.
